test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following table shows the sale of different brands of watches by a shop during 2014-2018.

 
 

 Year
 Brand (in thousands)
 
 

 Titan 
 Fastrack
 Timex
 Fossil
 
 

 2014 &nbs
solution:
**Given:**

Sales data for each options:

**Formula used:**

Percentage Increase = dfrac{(Current Year Sales - Previous Year Sales)}{Previous Year Sales} times 100

**Calculation:**

**Titan:**

2017 ⇒ Percentage Increase = dfrac{(412 - 312)}{312} times 100 ≈ 32.05%

**Fastrack:**

2017 ⇒ Percentage Increase = dfrac{(312 - 175)}{175} times 100 ≈ 78.29%

**Timex:**

2016 ⇒ Percentage Increase = dfrac{(388 - 285)}{285} times 100 ≈ 36.14%

**Fossil:**

2017 ⇒ Percentage Increase = dfrac{(146 - 112)}{112} times 100 ≈ 30.36%

**∴ The maximum percentage increase over the preceding year is for Fastrack in 2017, with an increase of 78.29%.**
